title: Severe pothole on main road
text: Huge deep pothole on MG Road near the metro pillar 45. Two two-wheelers skid and almost fell this morning. Please fix the broken road asphalt.

title: Dangerous road crater
text: Large crater and damaged road surface right at the intersection of Ring Road and 5th Cross. Traffic is backing up heavily.

title: Dark street due to broken streetlights
text: All street lights are off on 14th Main Road since last three nights. The lamp post is broken and the entire stretch is pitch dark.
description: Dark road and street lighting failure

title: Flickering street lamp pole
text: The light pole near Shivaji Park has been flickering and sparking intermittently. Tube light broken on the pole.

title: Broken walkway tiles on pedestrian path
text: Pedestrian sidewalk has missing pavers and broken footpath tiles near the bus stand. Senior citizens are tripping and falling.

title: Damaged curb and walkway
text: Broken pavement slabs on the footpath along Outer Ring Road. Construction debris left on walkway blocking pedestrians.

title: Sewage overflowing from blocked storm drain
text: The storm water drain is completely blocked with silt and plastic. Foul smelling sewage is overflowing onto the residential street.
description: Blocked storm drain with overflowing sewage

title: Clogged gutter causing waterlogging
text: The open naala gutter is choked with plastic waste. Wastewater is flooding into front yards and creating disease vector risks.

title: Uncovered open manhole on busy road
text: Missing manhole cover on 80 Feet Road right in front of the school. The open manhole pit is uncovered and extremely dangerous for vehicles and children.
description: Critical open manhole posing imminent hazard

title: Broken sewer hole chamber
text: Broken manhole cover fell through into the deep sewer hole chamber. No barricade or warning signage placed near the open sewer.
description: Broken manhole cover and open sewer

title: Drinking water pipeline leak
text: Clean drinking water is gushing out from a broken underground pipe near Sector 4 tank. Thousands of liters of water wasted on the street.

title: Major pipe burst on main road
text: A municipal water supply pipe burst under the pavement. Continuous water leaking creating a small river along the curb.

title: No water supply for 4 days
text: Our entire residential block has had no water supply since Tuesday. Taps are dry, municipal tanker hasn't arrived, no drinking water available.

title: Severe water shortage and dry taps
text: Water supply stopped without any prior notice. The taps have zero pressure and dry taps across all 50 houses in the colony.
description: Zero water pressure and dry taps

title: Massive garbage pile dumped on street
text: Uncollected garbage and waste dumped on the corner of Market Road. Stray cows and dogs are scattering trash everywhere. Huge foul stench.

title: Overflowing public rubbish bin
text: The municipal trash bin has not been cleared for two weeks. Rubbish heap is spilling onto the road creating a huge kachra dump yard.
description: Overflowing waste bin and kachra dump

title: Dead dog lying on highway
text: Dead animal found on the median of the highway near toll booth. The animal carcass has been decomposing for 24 hours and needs urgent removal.

title: Decomposing animal carcass
text: Dead stray animal body lying on the road corner attracting flies and emitting unbearable smell. Sanitary workers must collect carcass.

title: Live electric wire hanging low
text: Live wire hanging down to shoulder height right next to the school gate. Sparking wire touching a tree branch during rain.
description: Dangerous live hanging wires with sparking

title: Sparking overhead power cable
text: Loose electric wire snapped from the pole and is dangling across the road. Sparking cable risks electrocution for pedestrians.

title: Disgusting public toilet locked and dirty
text: The public toilet near the railway station is locked and completely unhygienic. The urinal is broken and there is no water in public washroom.

title: Unusable public washroom facility
text: Community public toilet lacks water supply, dirty washroom bowls are choked with feces, extremely unhygienic sauchalaya.

title: Sadak par bada gaddha hai
text: Main road par bahut bada khadda ho gaya hai gadiyan fas rahi hain sadak kharab ho chuki hai.

title: Bijli ka taar latak raha hai
text: Raste me bijli ka taar niche latak raha hai sparks nikal rahe hain electrocution ka khatra hai.

title: General civic inquiry regarding property tax office
text: Can someone please clarify the opening hours of the ward corporation office for grievance submission?
